verdict.rationale: Job results are returned as JSON by default, with SRT/VTT only as opt-in alternatives (docs-10). The output is organized into segments, which can carry speaker_id, configurable segment duration, and word-level start/end times (docs-8, docs-11, docs-13, docs-17). A segment-level confidence threshold filter (docs-16) implies each segment has a confidence score. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a confidence field in the response schema, a sample JSON response, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the output structure.
